test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question: Which of the following statements is FALSE?

options.text: Calcutta audiences have lauded Blind Opera.
Blind Opera is one of its kind in the world.
The blind can see in their own way.

solution:
​The correct answer is "**Blind Opera is one of its kind in the world**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **theme **of the comprehension passage is about blind opera, challenges overcome by blind opera members to impress the audience, and the purpose to reach the larger community of people with blindness who live in isolation. They want to establish a drama school that caters to all those who are economically and socially forced to stay on the periphery.
 
• In the **first **paragraph of the comprehension passage, it is mentioned that blind opera is one of its kind in the **country** and **Asia.**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**
